notes: Golden questions for WCAG retrieval. 'relevant' lists every success criterion that is a correct answer (a hit on any of them counts). Questions were written in the asker's own words, deliberately NOT copying W3C's wording, so keyword overlap can't inflate scores. 'lay' = how a site owner or user describes the problem; 'technical' = developer phrasing; 'named' = the question names the criterion (tests the exact-lookup shortcut, reported separately). Level A and AA criteria only, matching Parity's conformance target.
